title: RAW temporary cleansing changes a quality while lead remains lead despite silver-like appearance
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Steele ChapterI id00103 says lead's uncleanness can be wiped away for a time but not always; it remains lead although it seems silver, and strange qualities deceive people. Preserve treatment duration, material identity, appearance and observer error without turning cleansing into successful transmutation.

design.mechanism: An operation has a temporally limited effect on an unwanted quality of a retained material. The same source explicitly preserves material identity against a different apparent classification and assigns error to observers deceived by qualities. The absence of permanent cleansing does not mean that the material exists only temporarily; appearing silver is not being silver. Cleaning and silver-like appearance occur in the same argumentative passage, but an explicit because tying the operation to that precise appearance is not written.
design.unit: Previously owned full Steele Mediaeval Lore ChapterI, MEDIAEVAL SCIENCE: id00045 inclusive to id00109 exclusive,64 blocks. Focal source unit is the complete lead paragraph id00103, including kinds/origins, extraction, composition/impurity, limited cleansing and seeming, alleged softening power, melting conditions and cosmetic colors. Entire owned chapter reread in this pass; no new witness, fetch, image or target data.
design.contrast: R1: removing a quality transmutes lead into silver. R2: the negated permanence attaches to lead's identity rather than to cleansing. R3: appearance is an objective material classification and no observer can err. R4: purification has no actual even-temporary effect. R5: the neighboring gold medical paragraph's cure/concealment alternative proves an actual cure or independently corroborates the lead argument.
design.prediction: A faithful source-content account must allow temporary removal of uncleanness and persistent lead identity together; it must distinguish being lead, seeming silver and people erring about it. Reversing these owners or scopes changes the written consequence. It must also preserve that the operation is not permanent without deriving either permanent purification or successful transmutation. A list of metal/color names cannot retain this conjunction.
design.scope: Exploratory source-only hypothesis, no target meanings, four-role map, executor, new primitive requirement, selection or attestation claim. These are historical assertions in an edited anthology, not modern chemistry or medical advice. Prior project/old-card/status exposure persists; no blinding claim.

source_basis.locus: id00103 complete lead paragraph, within owned ChapterI
source_basis.quote: And with wiping and cleansing, this uncleanness of lead may be taken away for a time, but never for always; a man may wipe off the uncleanness but alway it is lead although it seemeth silver. But strange qualities have mastery therein and beguile men, and make them err therein.

assumptions_and_costs: The identity/surface distinction is explicit; the particular causal path from wiping to silver appearance is context-linked, not asserted with a because clause. No microscopic explanation is supplied.
The account asserts generic possibilities and limits, not two controlled observations or a measured time until impurity returns.
Lead's other asserted effects and its comparison when molten to quicksilver remain in the full paragraph. A simile does not silently reclassify its material.

Gold id00093 separately says filings prevent leperhood or namely hide it and make it unknown. This unresolved cure-versus-concealment alternative is not an actual cure observation and is not corroboration of lead cleansing.

The chapter's introduction is modern editorial framing; focal id00103 is a selected older account as presented in this edition. No complete medieval work, original-language witness or independent textual tradition has been acquired.
Actual future scientific selection requires exact predecessor review and a whole written target-content contract; none is supplied or repaired here.
